add.issue.name: AGENTS.md: squash freely, keeping every ticket's Epiq-Ref line

edit.description.md: "Squash only trivial commits sharing one ref" predates Epiq-Ref body lines. A squash commit now keeps every ticket by carrying their refs as `Epiq-Ref:` lines in its body, which commit-timeline parses anywhere in the body.

add.issue.comment.md: Solution: AGENTS.md points to the epiq skill for commit linking instead of restating it; the rebase-only, subject-prefix and one-ref-squash rules are gone. PR #507.
